faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.intro: Everything you need to know about Schooldom. Can't find an answer?
faq.stillQuestionsSubtitle: Our team responds within 2 hours during business hours.

pricing.a: K-12 schools pay ₦500 per term (3 months 15 days). Non-K12 institutions pay ₦200 per month. Both plans are flat rates — no per-student charges, no hidden fees.

pricing.q: What is the Child Monitor add-on?
pricing.a: Child Monitor is an optional add-on for K-12 schools at ₦1,000 per term. It provides real-time location tracking, screen activity monitoring, and safety alerts for students.

pricing.q: Are there setup fees or per-student charges?
pricing.a: No. Our pricing is completely flat. You pay one rate for the entire school regardless of how many students or staff members you add.

pricing.q: What is SchoolGate, and how is it priced?
pricing.a: SchoolGate is a lighter, standalone plan for schools that only want the attendance gate terminal - covering Attendance, Staff, Finance, and Students, not the full platform. It's billed per student per term: ₦700 on Basic (weekly SMS attendance report) or ₦1,500 on Premium (daily clock-in/out SMS plus the weekly report, with Child Monitor included free). Both plans also have a one-time ₦50,000 device fee. You can activate full Schooldom later at any time.

cbt.q: Can students take exams without internet?
cbt.a: Yes. Our Desktop CBT app is 100% offline-capable. Students take exams on local machines; results automatically sync to the cloud when internet is restored.

cbt.q: What Windows versions does the desktop CBT app support?
cbt.a: The Schooldom Desktop CBT app works on Windows 7, 8, 10, and 11. No upgrade required — we designed it specifically for schools with older hardware.
The CBT app locks the computer into exam mode — preventing tab switching, copy-paste, screenshots, and external applications. All session activity is logged.

cbt.q: Can I upload past questions as a question bank?
cbt.a: Yes. You can import questions via Excel/CSV or type them directly. Questions support images, equations, and multiple choice or theory formats.

finance.q: How do parents pay school fees?
finance.a: Parents can pay via card, bank transfer, or USSD through our secure payment processors, direct bank transfer with automated reconciliation, or in-person cash (recorded by the bursary). All payments generate instant digital receipts sent via SMS.

finance.q: Can Schooldom send invoice SMS to parents?
finance.a: Yes. When a new term begins or a payment is due, Schooldom automatically sends invoice SMS messages to parents with payment links.
The system tracks outstanding balances per student, generates aging reports, and can automatically restrict portal access for students with unpaid fees — configurable by the school.

finance.q: Does Schooldom support multi-term or full-year invoicing?
finance.a: Yes. You can create invoices for individual terms, the full academic year, or any custom period. Split-payment installments are also supported.

setup.q: How long does it take to set up?
setup.a: Most schools are fully operational within 4 minutes of registering. Our onboarding wizard guides you through school setup, and your dashboard is live immediately.

setup.q: Do you offer training for staff?
setup.a: Yes. Every new school gets a complimentary onboarding session. We also provide video tutorials, documentation, and a dedicated support channel.

setup.q: Can I migrate data from another school management system?
setup.a: Yes. We have import tools for student records, fee history, and exam data from Excel, CSV, and common formats. Our team can also assist with custom migrations.
Email, WhatsApp, and phone support during business hours. K-12 plans include priority support with faster response times.

security.a: Yes. All student data is processed in compliance with the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA). We maintain data processing agreements with all schools and conduct regular audits.

security.q: Where is my school data stored?
security.a: Your data is stored on AWS infrastructure in the West Africa region, ensuring low latency and compliance with Nigerian data residency requirements.

security.q: Can I export or delete my data?
security.a: Yes. You can export all school data at any time in standard formats (CSV, PDF, JSON). Data deletion requests are processed within 30 days of school termination.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy ("Policy") explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect information in connection with the SchoolDom platform ("Platform"), including the website, web application, and mobile applications for school administrators, teachers, students, and parents (collectively, "Applications"). By accessing or using the Platform, you agree to this Policy.
privacy.questionsSubtitle: Reach our Data Protection Officer at enquiry@schooldom.academy.

sections.title: Who We Are & Contact
paragraphs: For any privacy questions, requests, or complaints, contact us at enquiry@schooldom.academy.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect only data necessary to provide SchoolDom services. Data is provided by School Owners/Administrators, Users, or collected automatically:
list: **School Information:** School name, address, RC number, contact details, and subscription details provided by the School Owner during onboarding.
**User Account Information:** Name, email address, phone number, role, password, and profile details provided during account creation or by the School Administrator.

**Student Information:** Name, admission ID, date of birth, grade/class, gender, parent/guardian details, academic performance data, attendance records, and disciplinary reports. Provided by the School Administrator and processed on their behalf.
**Usage & Device Data:** IP address, device type, browser/OS, log data, pages viewed, features used, and access times. Collected automatically to improve performance and security.
**Communications:** Messages, support tickets, and feedback you send us.
**Cookies & Similar Tech:** We use cookies for authentication, preferences, and analytics.

sections.title: Lawful Basis & How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: Under GDPR/NDPR, we process data based on: contract, legitimate interest, consent, and legal obligation. We use your information to:
list: **Provide the Platform:** Create accounts, enable features like CBT, fees, attendance, and reporting.
**Communicate:** Send account updates, security alerts, and platform announcements. Marketing only with consent.
**Personalize Experience:** Show relevant dashboards, content, and recommendations based on role and activity.
**Support Schools:** Generate reports, enable parent-teacher communication, and fulfill requests from School Administrators.
**Improve & Secure:** Analyze usage, fix bugs, prevent fraud, and develop new features.
**Comply with Law:** Respond to legal requests and meet NDPR/GDPR obligations.
paragraphsAfter: School Administrators are the "Data Controllers" for student/parent data. Xcel Technologies acts as "Data Processor" for that data.

sections.title: Sharing & Disclosure
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. We share data only as follows:
list: **School Administrators:** School Owners/Admins can access User and Student data for their school only, as authorized by them.

**Service Providers:** Trusted third parties who host data, send emails/SMS, process payments, or provide analytics. All are bound by Data Processing Agreements to protect data and only use it for our purposes.
**Legal Compliance:** If required by Nigerian law, court order, or regulatory authority.
**Business Transfer:** If Xcel Technologies is merged or acquired, data may transfer subject to this Policy.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We keep data only as long as needed for the purposes above, or as required by law.
list: School account data: Retained while account is active + 2 years after closure for legal/audit needs.
Student academic records: Retained per instructions from the School Administrator, in line with school policy and education laws.
Logs & analytics: Retained for 12 months, then anonymized.
paragraphsAfter: You can request deletion anytime. We will delete or anonymize data unless law requires retention.

sections.title: Your Rights & Choices
paragraphs: Under NDPR and GDPR, you have the right to:
list: **Access:** Request a copy of your personal data.
**Correction:** Ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
**Deletion:** Ask us to delete your data, subject to legal exceptions.
**Object/Restrict:** Object to processing or request limits on how we use data.
**Portability:** Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
**Withdraw Consent:** Where we rely on consent, you can withdraw it anytime.
paragraphsAfter: To exercise rights, email enquiry@schooldom.academy. We will respond within 30 days as required by NDPR.
School Administrators should contact their school to access or delete student data, since schools control that data.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We use encryption, access controls, firewalls, and regular audits to protect data. All data is stored on servers with SOC 2 compliant providers.
No system is 100% secure. You're also responsible for keeping your password safe and not sharing login details.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: SchoolDom is designed for schools and will process personal data of children under 13 as provided by Schools. We process this data only on instruction from the School, which acts as Data Controller. Schools must ensure they have parental consent as required by law. We do not knowingly collect data directly from children.

sections.title: Cookies & Tracking
paragraphs: We use essential cookies for login/security and optional cookies for analytics/performance. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser. Blocking essential cookies may break login.

sections.title: International Data Transfers
paragraphs: If data is transferred outside Nigeria/EU, we ensure adequate protection via Standard Contractual Clauses or other NDPR/GDPR-approved mechanisms.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Policy to reflect changes in law or features. We'll post the new version here with a "Last Updated" date and notify School Administrators by email for material changes. Continued use means acceptance.

sections.title: Complaints
paragraphs: If you're unsatisfied with our response, you can lodge a complaint with the Nigeria Data Protection Commission at ndpc.gov.ng or your local EU data authority.
